description_en: Updates the remarks for an instance configuration
description_zh: 根据传入的参数更新实例备注信息
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-instance-config-remark --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000 --config-id Config-0000000 --remark API --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCloudGtmInstanceConfigRemark

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值： 
          
zh-CN：中文。

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance for which you want to update the remarks
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改备注信息的全局流量管理GTM3.0实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance configuration. A GTM instance can have multiple configurations if you add both an A record and an AAAA record for the same domain name. The ConfigId uniquely identifies the configuration that you want to update.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2797349.html
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例配置ID，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识本次需要修改的域名实例配置。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2797349.html 接口可查询域名实例对应的 ConfigId 值
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The new remarks for the configuration
parameters.help_zh: 备注，传入参数即为更新后的目标备注内容
parameters.name: remark

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful.

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
本次操作是否成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
